Learning objectives for this week:

- Conduct dimensionality reduction in data using PCA and understand its applications.
- Understand the purpose of clustering and its many types and variations.
- Perform k-means clustering and interpret the results.
- Choose right values of k in k-means using different measures.
- Understand and perform basic hierarchical clustering methods and interpret the resulting dendrograms.
